_: Brief templates for gated agents (gate reviewers and test-author), enforced by .claude/hooks/guard-agent-brief.js (enforces Decision 92; recorded as Decision 93). A brief to a listed subagent_type must equal its template with each placeholder filled. {round}: digits or after-loop. {pr}: #digits or none. {branch}: [A-Za-z0-9._/-]+, an existing local branch. {plan}: a plan file under .work/, an existing regular file. A placeholder repeated in one template binds one value.

CONSTRAINTS: Read-only. Never run git commit/add/reset/checkout/stash/restore/clean/switch/rm. Ignore `.claude/worktrees/**`.

templates.test-author:
TASK: Tests first, plan {plan}, branch {branch}. Read the plan and the requirements it cites; never read an implementation of it.
OBJECTIVE: A failing test for each acceptance criterion in the plan.
DONE WHEN: Your terminal message maps each test file and title to an acceptance criterion and ends with an EVIDENCE: line holding the failing run's command and summary.
CONSTRAINTS: Write only test files: `*.test.*`, `*.spec.ts`, `*.testkit.mjs`. Never write under `apps/web/e2e/redteam/`. Never run git commit/add/reset/checkout/stash/restore/clean/switch/rm. Ignore `.claude/worktrees/**`.
CONTEXT: None.
